Label: funding agency
definition: Organization that is funding the grant

Label: awardee
definition: Organization that is receiving funding from the grant

Label: name
definition: Human readable locally unique identifier for a grant
short description: Typically this a concatenation of the activity code and contact PI for NIH grants. Example: U24 Hawrylycz grant

Label: title
definition: Long form title for a grant
short description: Typically this is the project title from NIH grants

Label: identifier
definition: Unique identifier for a grant resolvable by external authority
short description: Typically this is the project number from NIH grants

Label: report symbol
definition: Resource location component in NIH RePorter URL
short description: Symbol in RePorter URL that redirects to project details page in RePorter. Example: 10350021
